cards.title: Managed Node Groups
items: Rolling upgrade: nodes are replaced one by one to minimize workload disruption
Auto draining: pods move to other nodes automatically
Version tracking: automatically selects a node AMI compatible with the control plane
Run via Console / AWS CLI / eksctl; configure behavior with maxUnavailable and PDB

cards.title: Self-managed Node Groups
items: Blue/green deployment: create a new node group, then migrate workloads
Rolling upgrade: drain and terminate nodes one by one, replacing them with new nodes
In-place upgrade: upgrade kubelet and the container runtime on existing nodes

cards.title: Fargate and validation
items: Fargate pods automatically use the latest platform version when newly scheduled
Existing Fargate pods keep their current platform version until restarted
After the upgrade, check node version, node status, and pod deployment
